question: does the I/P character representation measure motion, or threshold dither on a noisy continuous signal?
verdict: SATURATED: the delta is dominated by threshold dither, not motion.
consequence: A hard threshold on a noisy continuous signal makes the P-frame a dither map. The representation needs the MAGNITUDE of the change between keyframes, not the per-frame sign of a threshold test. That also un-saturates the ladder: cost then tracks real motion instead of a constant flip rate.
